front.title: Merkle-Anchored Model Weight Release and RATS-Attested Runtime Activation Binding for Edge and Cloud AI Fleets

abstract.t: Supply Chain Integrity, Transparency, and Trust (SCITT) provides transparent artifact statements, and Remote Attestation Procedures (RATS, RFC 9334) provide hardware/runtime attestation evidence. However, no existing internet standard defines an atomic cryptographic binding between a chunked AI model weight release manifest, a hardware-monotonic anti-rollback epoch counter, and a live RATS attestation result at the moment model weights are mapped into accelerator memory. This document specifies the Model Activation Binding Token (MABT) protocol, preventing load-time weight substitution, silent quantization downgrade, and rollback attacks across cloud and edge AI inference fleets.
